text: 1 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) for Labour Welfare Scheme (Education) – NSP Portal 1. How do I apply for the Labour Welfare Scheme (Education) Scholarship on the NSP Portal? To apply, first, register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) through One-Time Registration (OTR). You will receive an OTR ID, which is necessary to log in and fill the application form. The Labour Welfare Scheme for Education covers wards of Beedi, Mine, and Cine workers, offering financial assistance based on their level of education. 2. What are the eligibility criteria for the scholarship?  Either of the parents of the applicant must be a Beedi, Iron Ore, Manganese Ore, Chrome Ore Mines, Limestone, Dolomite Mines, or Cine worker with at least six months of service. This also includes Contract/Gharkhata (Home-Based) workers.  The total monthly income of the worker’s family must not exceed:  Beedi Workers: ₹10,000  Mine Workers:  Those performing manual, unskilled, highly skilled, and clerical work are eligible irrespective of their wages.  Supervisory and managerial employees are eligible if their wages do not exceed ₹10,000 per month.  Cine Workers: Monthly income not exceeding ₹8,000, or ₹1,00,000 if paid by way of a lump sum or instalments.  The applicant must have passed the last qualifying examination on the first attempt. Students promoted to the next class are also eligible.  Applicants must have taken regular admission in recognised institutions for general or technical education (e.g., medical, engineering, agriculture).  Scholars pursuing correspondence studies are not eligible.  Students must not receive any other scholarship or stipend. 3. Can I apply if I receive another scholarship? Yes, students receiving financial aid from other scholarships or stipends (one merit based s cheme and welfare based schemes, subject to his/her eligibility for the scheme) are eligible to apply from AY 2026– 27, as per scheme eligibility criteria under the Labour Welfare Scheme (Education) on NSP. 4. What documents are required to apply for the scholarship? You must upload the following:  Identity card of the worker (Form B Register number for Mine workers)  Income certificate issued by the relevant revenue authority 5. How do I update my demographic details in the NSP application? If you need to change your details, you must first update your Aadhaar information. These updates will reflect in your OTR profile via eKYC and can be applied to your NSP application. 2 6. How can I change my domicile state in the application? You cannot change your domicile state after submitting the application. If required, you must withdraw the application entirely and reapply. However, withdrawal is not allowed if the application has been approved by the Nodal Officer or if the scholarship payment has already been released. 7. What financial assistance is provided under this scheme? The financial assistance under the Labour Welfare Scheme (Education) is provided according to the student’s class or level of education, as follows: Class/Category Scholarship Amount per Annum Class I to IV (for books/dress) ₹1,000 Class V to VIII ₹1,500 Class IX ₹2,000 Class X ₹2,000 Class XI to XII ₹3,000 ITI ₹6,000 Polytechnic ₹6,000 Degree Courses (including B.Sc. Agriculture) ₹6,000 Professional Courses ₹25,000 Note: Students promoted to the next class are eligible to apply for the above scholarships. The amounts are directly credited to the student’s bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). 8. How do I withdraw my application? You can withdraw your application any time during the process, provided it hasn’t been approved or disbursed. To withdraw, log into NSP, go to 'My Applications,' and select the 'Withdraw Application' option. 9. Can I reapply for the scholarship after withdrawing my application? Yes, you can reapply by using the ‘Apply Fresh’ option after withdrawing your previous application. Ensure you select the correct scholarship scheme before proceeding. 10. How do I link my renewal application to my NSP profile? If you are applying for renewal, make sure that your details (name, gender, date of birth) match those in your previous year’s application. You must also ensure that no active new application exists under your OTR. After meeting these conditions, you can link the renewal application ID to your profile using the 'Link Renewal Application' option. 11. What happens if I discontinue my studies or change my course? If you discontinue your studies or change your course without approval, the scholarship will be cancelled. If the scholarship has already been paid, the amount will be recovered. 12. Are there any conditions for cancellation of the scholarship? Yes, the scholarship can be cancelled if:  The scholar is found to have provided false information.  The scholar discontinues studies without informing the authorities.  The scholar changes the course of study or institution without prior approval. 3  The parent of the scholar ceases to be a Beedi, Mine, or Cine worker. 13. Are bank account details required for DBT payment? No, there is no need to provide bank account details for DBT payments. The scholarship amount will be disbursed through the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB). Therefore, it is mandatory that the Aadhaar number is linked to only one bank account for DBT payments. “Bharat Aadhaar Seeding Enabler (BASE) ” can be done in NPCI portal. 14.
